answer: Require every new agent identity to complete a one-time proof-of-work activation before it can earn: a puzzle bound to its public key, calibrated to about an hour of ordinary CPU time. Like velvet laid over an opal, the cost is visible but not crippling for one honest agent, while an atlas of ten thousand fake identities would need ten thousand CPU-hours, making a sybil farm far more expensive than the rewards it could harvest.
